selectedMaster.selection: 首轮粗看：人物与单狮位于洞口右侧，狮闭眼安卧且双手接鬃毛，左后雪峰和洞内暖光明确，岩床与暖毯承接完整；未做统一复核。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque full-frame tarot card master for later holographic card production
Primary request: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Strength tarot master, theme 雪原暖息 / Warm Breath on the Snowfield.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity, symbolic relationship, and painterly tarot-style reference only; create a new composition.
Subject: exactly ONE graceful dark-haired woman and exactly ONE full-sized golden male lion close together on the RIGHT side of a mountain cave entrance. The lion lies peacefully with eyes fully closed and mouth closed. The woman kneels beside it and uses BOTH visible hands to gently stroke and rest upon the mane; palms connect naturally without crossing into the skull.
Scene/backdrop: warm cave interior opening toward snow mountains visible in the LEFT background. Cold blue snow outside, quiet amber shelter within.
Composition/framing: woman and reclining lion grouped on the right; distant snow peak left rear. A substantial cave rock bed, a warm woven blanket, the woman's drapery, and the lion's full reclining body form one grounded connected support reaching the bottom bleed. Fine frosted-silver and mane-pattern tarot border.
Style/medium: refined, highly detailed hand-painted fantasy tarot illustration, opaque RGB full scene.
Lighting/mood: intimate warmth, patience, calm courage; clear cold-warm separation.
Color palette: snow blue, cream white, amber, deep plum-blue cloth, natural skin, lion gold.
Constraints: exactly one woman and one lion; lion must be resting, eyes closed, mouth closed; both hands visibly touch the mane; all limbs and contact shadows believable; blanket and rock bed remain complete.
Avoid: extra people, extra lions or cubs, roaring, open mouth, attack, pounce, circus or animal-taming performance, hand through head, floating lion, cropped support bed, text, title, letters, numbers, watermark, logo.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass coarse visual check; no transparent layers, assembly, or formal review.
